comment: Exact-match phrases (after lowercasing and punctuation strip) that Whisper-family models emit on silent or near-silent audio. Two lists with different jobs: phrases guards WHOLE transcripts (a dictation that is only one of these is an artifact); artifactTails is the strict subset safe to strip off the END of real speech, because no one genuinely dictates them (a spoken thank-you or bye sign-off must always survive). Data-driven so new sightings land here, not in code.
phrases: see you in the next video
